stop_reason: No exercise contrast and no replication: (1) the intervention is hindlimb unloading/disuse and reloading, with no exercise or training arm; (2) every arm (cell type x treatment x duration) is ONE library of RNA pooled from 3-4 mice (S4.7.p1), so each comparison is n=1 vs n=1 with zero residual degrees of freedom. Between-sample variance cannot be estimated; the paper's 3991/1504 DEGs come from an edgeR exact test with an assumed dispersion of 0.2 (S4.8.p1), a fixed assumption rather than inference. No valid DE model exists for these data.
